fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

The `/deckcheck/` deck legality page listed cards that had Magic Online bugs (both game-breaking and playable) by card name only, with no indication of *what* the bug was. Players had to navigate away to look up the bug description.

## What changed

**`decksite/form.py`**
- `check_deck_legality()`: Changed the `banned_for_bugs` and `playable_bugs` set comprehensions to produce strings in the format `"Card Name — bug description 1; bug description 2"` instead of just `"Card Name"`. Cards with multiple bugs of the relevant type have their descriptions joined with `"; "`.
- `card_messages_with_submitted_aliases()`: Refactored to call a new helper `_name_with_alias()` that splits on `' — '` to extract the canonical card name before doing the alias lookup, then re-appends the description suffix. This preserves the existing "entered as" alias display for cards submitted under alternate names.

**`decksite/form_test.py`**
- Added `test_card_messages_preserve_bug_description_suffix`: verifies alias lookup still works when the name has a `— description` suffix.
- Added `test_card_messages_with_bug_description_no_alias`: verifies the description is passed through unchanged when no alias is present.

The `deckerrors.mustache` template already uses `{{.}}` to render each item in the list, so it displays the richer strings without any template changes.

## Validation

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed (all checks passed)
- `uv run --frozen pytest decksite/form_test.py -v` — 8 passed (MariaDB was running; `dev.py unit decksite` routes to a scraper path with no collected tests, so pytest was invoked directly on the test file)

Fixes #8595
